        "contents": "const HomePage: React.FC = \n;\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 加载精选项目\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;&amp; featuredResponse.data) {\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载最近项目\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;&amp; recentResponse.data) {\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\"全部\"和\"我的项目\"标签，或强制加载时）\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100,\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'last_opened_at' : sortBy === 'name' ? 'name' : 'created_at',\n          orderDirection: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\n        });\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;&amp; allResponse.data) {\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&gt; {\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\n    if (response.success) {\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\"我的项目\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\n      setActiveTab('my');\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\n      await loadProjects(true);\n    } else {\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&gt; {\n    // 更新最后打开时间\n    await projectService.updateLastOpenedAt(project.id);\n    // 导航到项目资源管理页面\n    navigate(&#96;/project/${project.id}/resources&#96;);\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectMenuClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, project: Project)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const handleCreateNewConversation = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      clearGlobalError();\n      // 提出新问题时，清空勾选状态和已发送来源\n      setSelectedSourceIds([]);\n      setSentSourceIds([]);\n      \n      const conversation = await aiSearchService.createConversation({\n        title: &#96;对话 ${new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN', { year: 'numeric', month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }).replace(/\\//g, '/')}&#96;,\n        sources: [], // 新对话不附带来源，等用户勾选后首次发送时传递\n        pageType: effectivePageType, // 使用包含项目ID的 pageType\n      });\n\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\n        persistWorkflowSelection(selectedWorkflowId, conversation.id);\n      }\n      await loadConversations({ activeConversationId: conversation.id });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"创建新对话失败:\", error);\n      reportError(\"创建新对话失败，请稍后重试\", error instanceof Error ? error.message : undefined);\n    }\n  }, [\n    clearGlobalError,\n    reportError,\n    selectedWorkflowId,\n    persistWorkflowSelection,\n    loadConversations,\n    effectivePageType,\n  ]);\n\n  const handleShowHistory = useCallback(() =&gt; {\n    setShowConversationList(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  // 标记来源已发送给 Dify，避免重复发送\n  const handleSourcesSent = useCallback((sourceIds: string[]) =&gt; {\n    setSentSourceIds(prev =&gt; {\n      const newIds = sourceIds.filter(id =&gt; !prev.includes(id));\n      if (newIds.length === 0) return prev;\n      return [...prev, ...newIds];\n    });\n  }, []);\n\n  const handleSelectConversation = async (conversation: Conversation)\n;\n;",

        "contents": "export const ChatHeader: React.FC&lt;ChatHeaderProps&gt; = ({\n  onResetConversation,\n  onOpenHistory,\n  onSave,\n  onExport,\n}) =&gt; (\n  &lt;div className=\"chat-header\"&gt;\n    &lt;div className=\"chat-status\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"status-indicator online\" /&gt;\n      &lt;span&gt;AI助手在线&lt;/span&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;div className=\"chat-actions\"&gt;\n      &lt;button\n        onClick={onResetConversation}\n        className=\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-md hover:bg-blue-600 transition-colors duration-200 shadow-sm text-sm\"\n      &gt;\n        &lt;Plus className=\"w-4 h-4\" /&gt;\n        &lt;span&gt;提一个新问题&lt;/span&gt;\n      &lt;/button&gt;\n\n      &lt;button\n        onClick={onOpenHistory}\n        className=\"flex items-center space-x-2 px-3 py-1.5 bg-green-500 text-white rounded-md hover:bg-green-600 transition-colors duration-200 shadow-sm text-sm\"\n      &gt;\n        &lt;Search className=\"w-4 h-4\" /&gt;\n        &lt;span&gt;搜索历史记录&lt;/span&gt;\n      &lt;/button&gt;\n\n      &lt;button className=\"chat-action-btn\" onClick={onSave}&gt;\n        &lt;Edit3 size={16} /&gt;\n        保存\n      &lt;/button&gt;\n      &lt;button className=\"chat-action-btn\" onClick={onExport}&gt;\n        &lt;FileText size={16} /&gt;\n        导出\n      &lt;/button&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  &lt;/div&gt;\n);",

tabFromUrl \n    : 'featured';\n  \n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState&lt;TabType&gt;(initialTab);\n  const [featuredProjects, setFeaturedProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [recentProjects, setRecentProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [allProjects, setAllProjects] = useState&lt;Project[]&gt;([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isNewProjectModalOpen, setIsNewProjectModalOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState&lt;'recent' | 'name' | 'date'&gt;('recent');\n\n  // 当 URL 参数变化时，更新 activeTab\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const tabFromUrl = searchParams.get('tab') as TabType | null;\n    if (tabFromUrl &amp;&amp; ['all', 'my', 'featured'].includes(tabFromUrl) &amp;&amp; tabFromUrl !== activeTab) {\n      setActiveTab(tabFromUrl);\n    }\n  }, [searchParams]);\n\n  // 加载数据\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    loadProjects();\n  }, [activeTab, sortBy]);\n\n  const loadProjects = async (forceLoadAll = false) =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      // 加载精选项目\n      const featuredResponse = await projectService.getFeaturedProjects(4);\n      if (featuredResponse.success &amp;&amp; featuredResponse.data) {\n        setFeaturedProjects(featuredResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载最近项目\n      const recentResponse = await projectService.getRecentProjects(20);\n      if (recentResponse.success &amp;&amp; recentResponse.data) {\n        setRecentProjects(recentResponse.data);\n      }\n\n      // 加载所有项目（用于\"全部\"和\"我的项目\"标签，或强制加载时）\n      if (forceLoadAll || activeTab === 'all' || activeTab === 'my') {\n        const allResponse = await projectService.getProjects({\n          page: 1,\n          pageSize: 100,\n          orderBy: sortBy === 'recent' ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'\n        });\n        if (allResponse.success &amp;&amp; allResponse.data) {\n          setAllProjects(allResponse.data.data);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载项目失败:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleCreateProject = async (data: ProjectFormData) =&gt; {\n    const response = await projectService.createProject(data);\n    if (response.success) {\n      // 创建成功后，切换到\"我的项目\"标签页以显示新创建的项目\n      setActiveTab('my');\n      // 强制重新加载所有数据（包括所有项目列表）\n      await loadProjects(true);\n    } else {\n      alert(response.error || '创建项目失败');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleProjectClick = async (project: Project) =&gt;           }
        },
        "contents": "const TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; =  =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const location = useLocation();\n  const [activeConfigs, setActiveConfigs] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfig[]&gt;([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [userMenuOpen, setUserMenuOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [currentUsername, setCurrentUsername] = useState&lt;string&gt;('用户');\n  \n  // 获取当前登录用户名\n  const getCurrentUsername = (): string =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 尝试从 localStorage 获取用户名（支持多种可能的键名）\n      const username = localStorage.getItem('username') || \n                       localStorage.getItem('user_name') || \n                       localStorage.getItem('currentUser') ||\n                       localStorage.getItem('userName');\n      if (username) {\n        // 如果是 JSON 字符串，尝试解析\n        try {\n          const parsed = JSON.parse(username);\n          return parsed.name || parsed.username || parsed.userName || username;\n        } catch {\n          return username;\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('获取用户名失败:', error);\n    }\n    // 默认返回\"用户\"\n    return '用户';\n  };\n  \n  // 初始化用户名\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n      setCurrentUsername(getCurrentUsername());\n    };\n    \n    window.addEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\n    \n    return () =&gt; {\n      window.removeEventListener('storage', handleStorageChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('userUpdated', handleUserUpdate);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 加载启用的公共页面配置\n  const loadActiveConfigs = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "import React from 'react';\nimport { Bot, Workflow, MessageSquare, ExternalLink, Sparkles, Settings as SettingsIcon } from 'lucide-react';\nimport TopNavigation from '../components/TopNavigation';\nimport { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';\n\n/**\n * AI统一管理页面\n * 整合AI角色、工作流、多窗口对话、公开页面四个核心功能的统一入口\n */\nconst AIUnifiedManagementPage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n\n  const managementModules = [\n    {\n      id: 'roles',\n      title: 'AI角色管理',\n      description: '创建和管理AI对话角色，关联Dify工作流配置',\n      icon: Bot,\n      color: 'blue',\n      path: '/ai-roles',\n      badge: '基础层',\n      features: [\n        '创建和配置AI角色',\n        '关联Dify服务器工作流',\n        '管理角色启用状态',\n        '测试Dify连接',\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      id: 'workflow',\n      title: 'Agent工作流',\n      description: '基于AI角色进行流程编排，创建智能工作流',\n      icon: Workflow,\n      color: 'green',\n      path: '/agent-workflow',\n      badge: '编排层',\n      features: [\n        '可视化工作流设计',\n        '节点编排和连接',\n        '工作流执行和测试',\n        '模板管理',\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      id: 'chat',\n      title: '多窗口对话',\n      description: '创建AI对话窗口，关联AI角色或Agent工作流',\n      icon: MessageSquare,\n      color: 'purple',\n      path: '/ai-chat-multi',\n      badge: '应用层',\n      features: [\n        '多窗口并发对话',\n        '工作流模式支持',\n        '实时对话交互',\n        '工作流执行监控',\n      ],\n    },\n    {\n      id: 'public',\n      title: '公开页面配置',\n,\n  ];\n;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "import React from 'react';",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "import { Bot, Workflow, MessageSquare, ExternalLink, Sparkles, Settings as SettingsIcon } from 'lucide-react';",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },

        "contents": "const TopNavigation: React.FC&lt;TopNavigationProps&gt; = \n() =&gt; {\n() =&gt; {\n\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  // 动态生成主要功能导航项\n  const mainItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 重新计算 mainItems，activeConfigs:', activeConfigs.map(c =&gt; ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, isActive: c.isActive, address: c.address })));\n    const items: NavigationItem[] = [];\n\n    // 按照固定顺序生成主要功能项\n    MAIN_NAV_ORDER.forEach((navItem) =&gt; {\n      // 如果是项目管理，直接添加\n      if (navItem.name === '项目管理') {\n        items.push({\n          id: 'home',\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 其他功能：从配置中查找对应的配置\n      const config = activeConfigs.find(\n        (c) =&gt; c.address === navItem.address || c.name === navItem.name\n      );\n\n      if (config) {\n        console.log(&#96;[TopNavigation] 找到配置 ${navItem.name}:&#96;, config);\n        items.push({\n          id: config.id,\n          label: config.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: &#96;/${config.address}&#96;,\n          disabled: false,\n          category: 'main',\n          configId: config.id,\n        });\n      } else {\n        console.log(&#96;[TopNavigation] 未找到配置 ${navItem.name}，将显示为禁用状态&#96;);\n        // 如果配置不存在，仍然显示但禁用\n        items.push({\n          id: &#96;placeholder-${navItem.address}&#96;,\n          label: navItem.name,\n          icon: navItem.icon,\n          path: navItem.path,\n          disabled: true,\n          category: 'main',\n        });\n      }\n    });\n\n    console.log('[TopNavigation] 生成的 mainItems:', items.map(i =&gt; ({ id: i.id, label: i.label, disabled: i.disabled })));\n    return items;\n  }, [activeConfigs]);\n\n  // 生成管理功能导航项\n  const managementItems: NavigationItem[] = useMemo\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const nodeComponents = {\n, // 推广策略节点\n};\n\nconst NodePage: React.FC = () =&gt; {\n  const { nodeType } = useParams&lt;{ nodeType: string }&gt;();\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [executionResult, setExecutionResult] = useState&lt;any&gt;(null);\n  const [aiRole, setAiRole] = useState&lt;AIRoleConfig | null&gt;(null);\n  const [rolesLoading, setRolesLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [roleError, setRoleError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [publicConfig, setPublicConfig] = useState&lt;PublicPageConfigPreview | null&gt;(null);\n  const [configLoading, setConfigLoading] = useState(true);\n\n  // 获取节点信息 - 将URL中的连字符转换为下划线\n  const nodeId = nodeType ? nodeType.replace(/-/g, \"_\") : null;\n  const node = nodeId ? getNodeById(nodeId) : null;\n  const NodeComponent = node\n    ? nodeComponents[node.type as keyof typeof nodeComponents]\n    : null;\n\n  // 加载公开页面配置（如果存在）\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPublicConfig = async () =&gt; {\n      if (!nodeType) {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        setConfigLoading(true);\n        // 尝试根据地址查找配置\n        const configData = await publicPageConfigService.getPublicConfigByAddress(nodeType);\n        if (configData &amp;&amp; configData.config) {\n          setPublicConfig(configData);\n          \n          // 如果配置中有角色，使用第一个角色\n          if (configData.roles &amp;&amp; configData.roles.length &gt; 0) {\n            const firstRole = configData.roles[0];\n            setAiRole({\n              ...firstRole,\n              createdAt: new Date(firstRole.createdAt),\n              updatedAt: new Date(firstRole.updatedAt),\n            });\n            setRolesLoading(false);\n            return;\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.log('未找到公开页面配置，使用默认方式加载:', error);\n      } finally {\n        setConfigLoading(false);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPublicConfig();\n  }, [nodeType]);\n\n  // 加载AI角色配置（如果没有从公开配置中获取）\n  useEffect\n\n;",
